slides.texte_overlay:
How to feel happy again
after a hard season
Start with your body. Sleep, food, water, movement. When you feel low, the basics matter more than any big life change. Start there, start small.
Make one small plan to look forward to. A dinner with a friend, a day trip, a concert. Having something ahead lifts your mood today.
Write three good things each evening. They can be tiny: good coffee, a kind word, sunshine. Your brain slowly learns to notice good again.
Reconnect with an old hobby. The guitar, the bike, drawing, football. What made you happy before can help bring you back.
Before: everything felt grey and repetitive. After: five minutes a day of history, art or science, and little moments of wonder came back.
slides.texte_sophia: Before: everything felt grey and repetitive. After: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Little moments of wonder came back.

slides.texte_overlay: Talk to someone. A friend, a family member, or a professional. Sharing what you feel makes it lighter and helps you see a way forward.
Accept that it takes time. Healing is not a straight line. Some days will be better than others, and that's completely normal.
